title: Google’s AI search changes upended online publishing
slides: Google's AI search just reshaped publishing—who wins?
Click-through rates dropped for most content sites.
But some publishers saw traffic surge instead.
Audit your referral data before your next content cycle.
Check one page's search traffic today.
thread_text:
1. Google's AI search is reshaping publishing

Click-through rates have dropped for most content sites as AI summaries replace clicks. Some publishers, however, are seeing traffic surge instead.

2. The traffic divide is growing

While many sites lose referrals, a few are capitalizing on the shift by optimizing for AI-driven search. Their strategies reveal what works.

3. What are the winners doing?

They focus on high-quality, authoritative content that AI models prefer to cite. This approach turns AI summaries into a traffic source.

4. Audit your referral data now

Before your next content cycle, examine which pages are losing or gaining traffic. This will guide your AI optimization efforts.

5. Check one page today

Look at a single page's search traffic in your analytics. If referrals are down, consider how AI summaries might be affecting it.
